info.title: SAS IDeaS Enterprise Unified MCP Platform
info.description: Master MCP Gateway hosting 168 Canonical Tools across SFDC, CMA, Optix, Confluence, Datadog, and UPS/FDS

post.description:
Direct JSON-RPC over HTTP POST handler.
Required by Microsoft Copilot Studio (AgenticLoop) and clients that post directly to the MCP endpoint.

Direct JSON-RPC over HTTP POST handler.
Required by Microsoft Copilot Studio (AgenticLoop) and clients that post directly to the MCP endpoint.
Receives JSON-RPC messages and routes responses through SSE queue.

get.description: Lists all 168 canonical enterprise tools and their schemas.
Reads content from a canonical enterprise resource URI.

post.description: Universal endpoint to invoke any of the 168 canonical tools dynamically.

Autonomous end-to-end investigation for a Salesforce Case across all 5 enterprise domains (Salesforce Case + UPS Property Config + CMA Spring Batch Chains + Datadog Error Logs + Confluence Runbooks). Produces root-cause hypotheses, failing components, and recommended remediation steps in 1 turn.

Autonomously diagnoses why pricing/rate uploads failed to publish to PMS or external partners. Inspects CMA decision delivery records (BAR, AgileRates, LRV), CEDF client upload enablement, and Datadog outbound APM timeout logs in 1 turn.

Automated 10-tab revenue and pace audit comparing Accom_Activity against PACE_Accom_Activity across STLY 364-day day-of-week shifts. Flags discrepancies exceeding tolerance (default 5%) with root-cause insights and remediation SOPs.
Retrieve complete details for a Salesforce Case from PostgreSQL clone in <50ms. Includes all 557 fields, case comments, and owner details.
Search and filter historical or active Salesforce cases using indexed attributes (account chain code, property name, product environment, status, priority).
Create a new Case record in Salesforce with instant dual-write to PostgreSQL clone and DLQ protection.
Update an existing Case record in Salesforce with immediate write-through to PostgreSQL clone.
Add a CaseComment note to a Salesforce Case with dual-write to PostgreSQL clone.
Retrieve the field audit trail history for a case (tracking changes to Status, Owner, Priority).
Retrieve the unified Activity History for a Salesforce case (all completed tasks and past calendar events dynamically merged).
Retrieve full task details and parent case context by task ID or task number from PostgreSQL clone in <10ms.
Search operational tasks by status, assignee, priority, case number, or subject keyword with full pagination.
Create a new Salesforce Task attached to a Case or Account with instant write to Salesforce and Postgres.
Update an existing Task (status, priority, subject, description) in Salesforce and Postgres.
Safely reassign a Salesforce Task to another engineer or queue with dual-sync across Postgres.
Retrieve live aggregated team and queue workload metrics from the pre-aggregated summary table.
Retrieve complete details for a client Account from PostgreSQL clone (Chain Code, Brand, Property Name, Salesforce Account ID).
Search the 94k accounts directory by chain code, brand, country, or keyword in <15ms.
Resolve any past or present engineer, consultant, or queue from the complete 15k users catalog in PostgreSQL clone.
Retrieve hotel or client contacts by contact ID, email, or account ID.
Retrieve RMS PMS/CRS integration profiles (Overbooking Controls, Decision Modes, System Types).
Upload a file (diagnostic report, Excel audit, screenshot) as a ContentVersion attached to a Case or Task.
List all files and attachments linked to a Salesforce Case or Task.
Introspect the schema, queryable fields, relationships, and types of any Salesforce standard or custom object.
Retrieve valid picklist options for any field (e.g. Case.Status, Case.Priority).
Execute arbitrary read-only SQL queries against the local PostgreSQL clone (344,000+ cases, 557 columns).
Execute arbitrary read-only SOQL queries directly against live Salesforce via the SFDC Middleware.
Generic insert or update for ANY standard or custom Salesforce object via Middleware.

Execute arbitrary SQL query on any G3 chain or tenant database.
    
    Args:
        chain: Target database chain name (e.g. 'global_PROD_1', 'job_PROD_1', 'ratchet_PROD_1', or 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        query: SQL query to execute. SQL comments are automatically stripped.
        timeout: Query timeout in seconds (default 35.0).

Execute multiple SQL queries across multiple database chains concurrently in a single batch.
    
    Args:
        chains: List of database chain names (e.g. ['global_PROD_1', 'global_PROD_2']).
        queries: List of SQL queries to execute on each chain.
        timeout: Batch execution timeout in seconds (default 60.0).

Search across 19,496+ cached database chains by keyword, hotel code, or client identifier.
    
    Args:
        keyword: Search term (e.g. 'Hilton', 'ATLFY', 'global_PROD', '0018').
        chain_type: Filter by chain type: 'all', 'global', 'job', 'ratchet', or 'tenant'.
        limit: Max results to return (default 50).

Paginate and list database chains from the catalog.
    
    Args:
        chain_type: Filter by category: 'all', 'global', 'job', 'ratchet', or 'tenant'.
        limit: Number of items per page (default 100).
        offset: Offset for pagination (default 0).

Get metadata for a specific database chain, with optional live ping connectivity verification.
    
    Args:
        chain_name: Exact database chain name (e.g. 'global_PROD_1', 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        test_connection: If True, executes 'SELECT 1' on the chain to verify live connectivity.

Automatically identify which G3 production cluster (PROD_1..6) hosts a client or hotel.
    
    Args:
        client_code: Client code (e.g. 'Hilton', 'BSTN', 'IHG').
        property_code: Property short code (e.g. 'ATLFY', 'H1', '0018').

Retrieve all properties owned or operated by a client group across G3 Global databases.
    
    Args:
        client_code: Client code (e.g. 'BSTN', 'Hilton', 'IHG').
        global_chain: G3 Global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').

List tables and views on any database chain (Global, Job, Ratchet, or Tenant) matching a wildcard pattern.
    
    Args:
        chain: Database chain name (e.g. 'global_PROD_1', 'job_PROD_1', 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        pattern: Wildcard search pattern (e.g. '*PACE*', '*USER*', '*PARAM*', '*JOB*'). Defaults to '*'.

Reflect table schema: column names, data types, nullability, character lengths, and default values.
    
    Args:
        chain: Target database chain name (e.g. 'global_PROD_1', 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        table_name: Table name to describe (e.g. 'Property', 'Accom_Activity', 'JOB_INSTANCE').

Retrieve full Property configuration, Client linkage, and stage mode audit history.
    
    Args:
        property_id: Numeric Property_ID (e.g. '5').
        property_code: Property short code (e.g. 'H1', 'LONME', 'ATLFY').
        client_code: Optional client code to narrow lookup.
        global_chain: G3 Global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').
        include_audit_history: If True, fetches recent stage transitions from Property_AUD (default True).

Resolve cascading configuration parameters across pacman -> pacman.CLIENT -> pacman.CLIENT.PROP.
    
    Args:
        client_code: Client code (e.g. 'Hilton', 'BSTN').
        property_code: Property short code (e.g. 'ATLFY', '0018').
        parameter_names: List of specific parameter names to inspect. If omitted, retrieves all parameters.
        global_chain: G3 Global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').

Retrieve PMS/RMS interface configurations, datafeed endpoints, and FTP settings.
    
    Args:
        property_id: Numeric Property_ID.
        client_code: Client code (e.g. 'BSTN', 'Hilton').
        global_chain: G3 Global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').

Inspect Spring Batch execution logs, statuses, and runtimes in G3 Job databases.
    
    Args:
        job_name: Name of batch job (e.g. 'continuousPricingJob', 'strFileIngestionJob', 'etlJob').
        job_chain: G3 Job database chain (default 'job_PROD_1').
        param_key: Filter parameter name (e.g. 'propertyId', 'sendingSystemPropertyId', 'clientCode').
        param_value: Value for the param_key filter.
        after_datetime: ISO datetime string to filter runs after (e.g. '2026-01-01 00:00:00').
        limit: Max executions to retrieve (default 10).

Retrieve failed batch executions with step-level error traces and exit codes.
    
    Args:
        job_chain: G3 Job database chain (default 'job_PROD_1').
        hours_back: Hours to look back for failures (default 24).
        limit: Max failed executions to return (default 20).

Check for stuck, blocked, or throttled batch jobs in the job cluster.
    
    Args:
        job_chain: G3 Job database chain (default 'job_PROD_1').

Retrieve aggregated daily job throughput, success rates, and average durations.
    
    Args:
        job_chain: G3 Job database chain (default 'job_PROD_1').
        days_back: Days of historical stats to retrieve (default 7).

Safely query tenant database tables (e.g. OCCUPANCY, TRANSACTIONS, RESERVATIONS, RATE_CODES).
    
    Args:
        chain: Tenant database chain name (e.g. 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        table_name: Target table name.
        where_clause: Optional WHERE clause without 'WHERE' (e.g. "OCCUPANCY_DATE >= '2026-01-01'").
        columns: Specific columns to project. Defaults to '*' if omitted.
        order_by: Optional ORDER BY clause without 'ORDER BY'.
        limit: Max rows to return (capped at 5000, default 100).

Aggregate actual rooms sold, room revenue, and ADR from tenant Accom_Activity for reconciliation.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        start_date: Start date YYYY-MM-DD.
        end_date: End date YYYY-MM-DD.

Retrieve the latest pacing snapshot (STLY rooms sold and revenue) from tenant PACE_Accom_Activity.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-ATLFY').

Query Standard Rate Plan (SRP) mappings, channel groups, and SRP attributes in the G3 Ratchet database.
    
    Args:
        client_code: Client short code (e.g. 'HILTON').
        property_code: Property short code (e.g. 'LONLK').
        srp_name: Optional SRP name filter (e.g. 'BAR', 'PGFCM1').
        group_name: Optional SRP group filter (e.g. 'AGENT', 'GRP').
        ratchet_chain: Ratchet chain name (default 'ratchet_PROD_1').
        limit: Maximum records to return (default 50, max 200).

post.summary: Cma Get Sfdc Case Audit History
post.description:
Search CMA portal audit logs for every query executed against a specific Salesforce Case Number.
    
    Args:
        case_number: 8-digit Salesforce Case Number (e.g. '03019231').
        start_date: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to 1 year ago).
        end_date: End date YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to tomorrow).

Retrieve the exact SQL query text, parameter hints, and execution metadata for a given CMA audit_id.
    
    Args:
        audit_id: CMA numeric audit transaction ID (e.g. '881559367').

Search the 2,000+ curated engineering SQL queries saved in CMA by SFDC Case, keyword, or tag.
    
    Args:
        keyword: Search term in query name or description (e.g. '03019231', 'MGM', 'DTA', 'Wash Override').
        tag: Operational tag filter (e.g. 'L2 Support', 'IM', 'Overbooking', 'FPLOS', 'Pace Alert', 'Casper').
        query_type: SQL operation type: 'Select', 'Insert', 'Update'.
        limit: Max results to return (default 30).

Retrieve full parameterized SQL code, assigned roles, and parameters for a saved query from CMA library.
    
    Args:
        query_id: Query ID in CMA viewSql library (e.g. '2467', '2596').

Retrieve live feed of queries and background tasks currently being executed across the team in CMA.
    
    Args:
        limit: Max tasks to return (default 20).

post.summary: Cma Get Task Status By Job Id
post.description:
Search and inspect real-time progress of a CMA background batch task by its Job ID.
    
    Args:
        job_id: Numeric Job ID (e.g. '348244').
Discover available remote server explorer nodes (G3 Prod 1..6 and RSS Prod 1..6 data directories).

post.summary: Cma Get Property System Parameters Catalog
post.description: Retrieve the master catalog of Property System Parameters (PSPs) and active Cognito JWT tokens.
Inspect active recurring scheduled SQL jobs, execution frequencies, and target chains in CMA.
Inspect active CMA session status, cookie validity, and circuit breaker status.

Trigger the Chrome/Edge Virtual Desktop SSO auto-login to renew an expired JSESSIONID.
    
    Args:
        force: If True, triggers re-login even if cooldown period is active.
Force an immediate refresh and reload of the 19,496+ cached database chains.

Retrieve recent query audit logs and performance metrics from the gateway database.
    
    Args:
        limit: Max rows to return (default 50).
        status_code: Optional status code filter (e.g. 200, 500, 503).
        client_name: Optional client name filter.
Comprehensive telemetry report: throughput, latencies, cached chains, and error counts.

Inspect granular outbound decision delivery upload records, upload types, and status from the tenant database.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK', 'Hilton-ATLFY').
        decision_name: Optional filter: 'fplos', 'DailyBAR', 'roomtypeoverbooking', 'hoteloverbooking', 'inventoryLimit'.
        limit: Max records to return (default 25, max 100).

Verify whether decision changes actually occurred versus zero differential activity across recent runs.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK').
        days_back: Lookback window in days (default 7).

Check for vendor room types in PMS mapping tables that may be unmapped or inactive in G3 RMS.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK').

Check for vendor rate codes and market segment mappings configured for the property.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK').

Check market segment product mappings and missing extract configurations in the tenant database.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK').

Query datafeed endpoint status and FTP configuration in the global database.
    
    Args:
        global_chain: Target global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').
        client_code: Optional client organization short code (e.g. 'Hilton', 'CHOICE').

Check the latest occupancy and BDE dates in Accom_Activity and PACE tables to diagnose datafeed ingestion lag.
    
    Args:
        tenant_chain: Target tenant database chain (e.g. 'Hilton-LONLK').

Inspect historical changes to a PACMAN parameter in Envers Config_Parameter_Value_AUD (who modified it, old/new values, and timestamps).
    
    Args:
        parameter_name: Exact or prefix parameter name (e.g. 'pacman.feature.isContinuousPricingEnabled', 'pacman.forecasting').
        global_chain: Target global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').
        limit: Max audit events to return (default 25, max 100).

Retrieve internal G3 User ID (Users.User_ID), status, client, and Cognito identity from the global database.
    
    Args:
        username_or_email: Username, Screen_Name, or email address (e.g. 'Omkar Chitnis', 'omkar.chitnis@ideas.com').
        global_chain: Target global database chain (default 'global_PROD_1').
Probes all 3 Optix MSSQL production cluster nodes (optix-db-01, optix-db-02, optix-db-03) and returns real-time TCP connectivity, round-trip latency, MSSQL version, and online tenant database counts.
Returns the complete catalog of all 427+ tenant databases indexed across all 3 Optix cluster nodes, including the exact node hosting each database. Supports optional search filter pattern.
Resolves the exact cluster node (host/IP) and database name for a given client code (e.g. 'ALTHOFF', 'SONESTA', '1666') or property code. Uses exact, prefix, suffix, and metadata heuristics.
Returns aggregate cluster metrics including active nodes, total indexed tenant databases, routing cache stats, query execution counters, and server uptime.
Executes an arbitrary read-only SQL query against any Optix tenant database or cluster node. Automatically adds NOLOCK hints, blocks all DDL/DML, and enforces row limits and timeouts.
Executes a batch of read-only queries in sequence across one or more Optix databases. Returns structured results grouped by query label.
Returns estimated query execution plan and cost analysis for a given SQL query using SET SHOWPLAN_ALL ON without executing the query.
Lists all tables and views in an Optix tenant database. Supports filtering by schema (dbo, STAGE, SPOT, RMS) and name wildcard search.
Returns comprehensive schema definition for a table or view: column names, data types, nullability, max lengths, primary key flags, and foreign key references.
Returns exact row count and total storage space (in KB) for tables in a tenant database using sys.dm_db_partition_stats.
Searches for column names matching a pattern across all tables and views in an Optix tenant database (e.g. search for 'accom_revenue', 'calendar_id', 'as_of').
Retrieves all properties configured in an Optix tenant database from Dim_Property (property_id, property_cd, property_nm, currency_cd, status_id, pms_property_id, ups_id, time_zone_txt).
Resolves a property code (unpadded or padded, e.g. '10' vs '0010') to its internal Optix numeric property_id, official name, and currency in Dim_Property.

Audits feature flags from Feature and Feature_Property tables in an Optix tenant database, including the 5 mandatory RMS flags (enableCompetitiveRatesEtl, enableCompetitiveRatesDashboard, enablePMSInboundProfileData, dashboard.travel_agent, dashboard.company).
Retrieves property hierarchy tree, groups, and estate configurations from Property_Group, Property_Group_Master, and vw_property_hierarchy.
Extracts total rooms sold, accommodation revenue, F&B revenue, beverage, other revenue, and gross revenue for a property across a date range from Fact_Daily_Activity.
Granular day-by-day drill-down of solds, room revenue, and ADR across stay dates (calendar_id) from Fact_Daily_Activity. Supports up to 1,095 stay dates.
Hierarchical rollups by Year (YYYY), Month (YYYY-MM), and Day (YYYYMMDD) for long-term trend analysis and multi-year comparisons from Fact_Daily_Activity.
Extracts forward On-The-Books (OTB) booking pace for future stay dates from today onwards from Fact_Daily_Activity (calendar_id >= TODAY).
Summarizes forward 365-day booking horizon aggregated by future calendar month (OTB Solds, Revenue, ADR) from Fact_Daily_Activity.
Extracts historical Same Time Last Year (STLY) pace with 364-day (52-week DOW matched) snapshot from Fact_Daily_Activity_Pace using the latest as_of_calendar_id.
Extracts final settled actuals for the 364-day prior occupancy dates from Fact_Daily_Activity for YoY growth reconciliation.
Lists available snapshot dates (as_of_calendar_id) in Fact_Daily_Activity_Pace for a property, showing row counts and date horizons.
Reconciles accommodation solds, revenue, and ADR by PMS market segment and analytical split category from Fact_Daily_Activity joined with Dim_Market_Property.
Lists all configured market segment dimensions in Dim_Market_Property (market_property_cd, market_property_nm, market_segment_type).
Reconciles accommodation solds, room revenue, and ADR by physical and logical room category from Fact_Daily_Activity joined with Dim_Accom_Property.
Lists all configured room type dimensions in Dim_Accom_Property (accom_property_cd, accom_property_nm).
Performs comprehensive 3-tier group reconciliation: Tier 1 Unpicked Blocks ('B'), Tier 2 Materialized Group Pickup ('R'), Contracted Block Revenue, Pickup Revenue, and Total Group Revenue.
Queries specific group master definitions, contracts, and status from Dim_Group and STAGE.Group_Master.
Partitions hotel performance into commercial Business Views: Transient, Group, Contract & Crew, and House Use / Other Business Views.
Quality anomaly scanner detecting unmapped dimensions (-2, 0, 'ZNV'), complimentary zero-revenue stays with active solds, and late cancellation fees without solds.
Computes exact discrepancy percentage between G3 RMS source metrics and Optix DW metrics with the official <5% tolerance check and automated pass/fail determination.
Inspects recent ETL and data processing batch runs from Process_History or Processing_Batch (Batch_ID, Status, End_Time, row counts, error messages).
Flushes the in-memory database routing cache and initiates a full live re-index of all databases across all cluster nodes.
Returns routing cache statistics, cache hit/miss ratio, indexed database counts, and query counters.

Searches Atlassian Confluence documentation by text or title using CQL. If Cloud API is unavailable or unauthenticated, automatically falls back to searching vector memory and 274 local markdown guides.
Executes raw Atlassian Confluence Query Language (CQL) expressions (e.g. 'space = "OPTIX" and type = page order by lastmodified desc').
Performs dense semantic vector search across Qdrant vector memory collections (confluence_kb, g3_help_docs_kb, g3_knowledge).
Searches for Confluence pages tagged with specific operational labels (e.g. 'runbook', 'sfdc', 'optix', 'troubleshooting', 'cma').
Fetches the full clean readable markdown/text content of an Atlassian Confluence page by numeric page ID.
Finds and fetches full page content given a page title and space key.
Retrieves version history, authors, modification timestamps, and change comments for a Confluence page.
Retrieves all labels and tags applied to a specific Confluence page.
Lists all accessible Confluence spaces with space keys, names, descriptions, and web URLs.
Returns detailed metadata for a specific Confluence space: name, description, homepage ID, and web link.
Paginated listing of pages within a target Confluence space.
Lists direct child pages nested under a parent Confluence page ID.

Retrieves the complete technical troubleshooting guide, identification technique, and remediation steps for a known operational issue key (e.g. 'HTNG_STATS_VS_INVENTORY', 'PSEUDO_ROOM_TYPE_FILTER', 'CRS_DATA_NOT_ARRIVED', 'JOB_DB_LOCK_DEADLOCK_FPLOS', 'GROUP_PRICING_HIERARCHY_NPE', 'OXI_PMS_MESSAGE_TRACE', 'SFTP_CHECKSUM_VERIFICATION').
Catalogs all 7+ core engineering diagnostic runbooks derived from production postmortems, including operational domains and page links.
Analyzes an observed error string, stack trace, or case description and matches the most applicable engineering runbook.
Comprehensive engineering knowledge lookup: automatically matches relevant runbooks, official Swagger API specifications, S3 portals, and local documentation.
Catalogs all 13 official microservice Swagger/OpenAPI endpoints across PROD, STAGE, and DEV tiers (UPS, UIS, UAS, BMR, AIS Outbound, PMS Inbound, Decision Delivery, STR, TARS, FOLS).
Returns the Swagger UI and OpenAPI documentation URL for a specific microservice (e.g. 'UPS', 'AIS Outbound Manager', 'PMS Inbound').
Searches across official microservice Swagger catalogs for matching REST endpoints and operational domains.
Catalogs internal S3 explorers and object storage portals: Atlantis S3 Explorer, Atlantis Pull-SFTP Observability, and Analytics Lakehouse Trino buckets.
Returns direct links to Atlantis S3 Explorer for browsing raw drop files, differential snapshots, and extract payloads.
Performs full-text keyword search across 274 local markdown G3 Help Docs (Release Notes, Configuration Overviews, System Settings, Budget, Forecast).
Fetches the full markdown text of a specific G3 help documentation file by filename.
Reports vector memory statistics and point counts for Qdrant collections: confluence_kb, g3_help_docs_kb, g3_knowledge, g3_schema_kb.
Initiates synchronization of pages from an Atlassian Confluence space into Qdrant vector memory collection confluence_kb.

Retrieves the master SRE incident triage playbook and Zero-DB resolution steps for a given failure key or symptom (e.g. 'PRICING_SCREEN_INCORRECT_SYNTAX', 'BATCH_DEADLOCK', 'DECISION_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT', 'UNMAPPED_DIMENSIONS_TRIAGE', 'CEDF_DATA_LAG_STALE_IMPORT', 'COMPETITIVE_CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT', 'HAL_CONFIG_DESYNC').

Searches the complete SAS IDeaS Master Operations & Architecture Knowledge Base (subsystems, 4 transport topologies, Zero-DB compliance rules, error codes, click-paths, and playbooks) for relevant guidance.
Returns comprehensive architecture, failure modes, diagnostic tools, and recovery actions for external PMS/CRS transport mechanisms (NGI, Direct URL / HTNG, CEDF SFTP, Ratchet SRP).
Returns exact click-by-click G3 RMS UI navigation paths, save procedures, and verification checks for non-database operational fixes.

Retrieves technical metadata, business purpose, key columns, system usage, and safe read-only SQL query template for any table in Global DB (213 tables), Job DB (25 tables), or Tenant DB (1,011 tables).

Fuzzy searches the 1,249+ table catalog across Global DB, Job DB, and Tenant DB by keyword or functional concept (e.g. 'room', 'rate', 'pricing', 'parameter', 'lock', 'deadlock', 'decision', 'forecast', 'segment', 'batch').

post.summary: Kb List Db Tables By Module
post.description: Lists all tables organized by functional business module for Global DB, Job DB, or Tenant DB (e.g. 'Parameter Hierarchy', 'Property Master', 'Analytics', 'Pricing', 'Inventory', 'Decisions').
Retrieves diagnostic attribution, technical root cause, affected subsystem layer, diagnostic SQL, and Zero-DB UI remediation for IDeaS, SQL Server, Oracle, BDE, and Kafka error codes/patterns.
Generates verified, safe, read-only SQL queries with WITH (NOLOCK) and TOP 50 caps tailored for investigating specific incident scenarios across Tenant DB, Job DB, Global DB, and Optix DW.

Returns an end-to-end multi-system SRE investigation matrix for an incident type, detailing Datadog APM metrics/logs to search, exact SQL tables and queries to inspect, CMA batch chains to review, transport checks, and sister property comparative validation.
Searches production log events in Datadog using the Logs Search API v2. Supports custom queries, date ranges, service filters, and status filters.

post.summary: Datadog Search Logs By Job Id
post.description: Searches for log events and execution traces specifically associated with a Spring Batch or RMS Job ID (@job_instance_id or @job_execution_id).
Retrieves recent error and critical logs (status:error OR status:critical) for a given microservice with full stack traces.
Traces an end-to-end transaction across all microservices using a unique correlationId, transaction ID, or requestTransactionId.
Lists active IDeaS microservices and their operational domains monitored within Datadog.
Calculates health telemetry for a service: total log volume, error count, warning count, and error ratio over the past 24 hours.
Searches logs emitted by specific cloud hosts, EC2 instances, or ECS containers.
Fetches the most recent live log stream for a service or tag in the past 15 minutes.
Lists configured Datadog monitors, overall states (OK, Alert, Warn, No Data), and notification policies.
Fetches detailed threshold triggers, query expressions, and status history for a specific monitor ID.
Returns all monitors currently in an 'Alert' or 'Warn' state across production RMS environments.
Checks synthetic API and web browser test results for endpoint availability and response times.
Queries raw timeseries metrics from Datadog Metrics API v1 (e.g. 'avg:system.cpu.user{*}', 'avg:jvm.heap_memory{*}').
Queries database connection pool usage, active connections, and lock metrics for MSSQL and PostgreSQL clusters.
Analyzes p50, p95, and p99 request latencies for core API gateways.
Aggregates recurring error types and frequencies grouped by service and error message patterns.
Lists active or recently resolved Datadog production incidents and customer impact summaries.
Queries Datadog user audit trails (dashboard edits, monitor muting, API key creation).
Validates Datadog API Key and Application Key permissions and connectivity to datadoghq.com.
Reports server uptime, total queries executed, error counts, and site configurations.
Deep log tracer across PMS inbound microservices (pmsinbound-internal, htng, ais) filtered by propertyCode, reservationId, or error status.
Searches Datadog error logs across outbound decision delivery pipelines (decision-delivery-internal, bmr-be-mo-service, ais-outbound-manager) for connection timeouts, schema rejections, and dropouts.
Returns the active status of the FDS M2M OAuth2 token, including TTL in seconds, renewals count, and endpoint connectivity.
Forces an immediate refresh of the FDS M2M OAuth2 Bearer token from the UIS OAuth2 service.
Retrieves comprehensive property details from UPS by unifiedId (name, chains, address, coordinates, hotelCapacity, salesforceAccountId, appConfig, vendorMappings, channels).
Performs advanced search across 100,000+ enterprise properties using application configuration filters (clientCode, propertyCode, pmsPropertyId), chain code, postal code, or name.
Extracts the application-specific configuration object for a property (e.g. 'g3', 'centralrms', 'elevate', 'revplan'), returning tenantDBHost, tenantDBName, hostUrl, and propertyCode.
Extracts competitive rate shopping vendor mappings for a property (RateGain, Rubicon, OTA Insight, TravelClick, etc.).
Retrieves distribution and OTA channels configured for a property (Booking.com, Expedia, GDS, Sabre, Ctrip, etc.).
Finds competitor or sister properties within a specified radius (in meters or kilometers) of a target property using geo-coordinates.
Retrieves business custom attributes defined on a property (e.g. RDRM, Management Type, Brand Code, Number of Rooms, Property Owner, Open Status).
Fetches property UUIDs modified, created, or audited across the platform within the last 24 hours.
Lists enterprise clients from the UPS directory (1,280+ clients) with optional search filter and pagination.
Fetches client organization metadata by clientCode or clientId (e.g. 'HILTON', 'JENKINS', 'CHOICE').
